en.title: Can Guitar Frets Perform Multiplication? Exploring an Analog Computing Idea
en.hook: A quirky look at whether the physical layout of guitar frets could be used for analog multiplication.
key_takeaways: Examines how fret spacing follows a logarithmic scale, potentially enabling analog multiplication
Discusses the theoretical feasibility versus practical limitations
Highlights creative inspiration from musical instruments for computing concepts
